comparison.objective: Roll puff pastry into an even 3 mm sheet at least 20 cm long; the candidate configures and locks a robot gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1694 tests coordinated rolling-pin control over deformable material, levelness, repeated passes, and safe set-down. The candidate tests small-tool seating, screw adjustment, wrench counterholding, and mechanism cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1694 grades sheet length, thickness uniformity, evenness, and final pin release, with partial credit for incomplete rolling. The candidate grades angle tolerance, lock and nut retention, repeated return accuracy, drift, and clearance. No material rubric details are missing, though PR-1694 explicitly uses a non-colliding scored dough approximation.
comparison.reason: The tasks test unrelated abilities: distributed deformable-material thickness control versus localized coupled fastener adjustment and retained articulated calibration.
